newsitem.title: UK: GEC firm after restructuring reports.
newsitem.headline: GEC firm after restructuring reports.

text.p: Shares in General Electric Co Plc firmed in pre-market trade on Monday after weekend press reports of imminent restructuring moves at the electronics and defence group.
The stock was quoted up 1-1/2p at 381-1/2 by 0703 GMT, in volume of 75,000 shares.
A report in the Sunday Times said the results of a strategic reviews to be announced on Tuesday by GEC chief executive George Simpson would show the company expanding its Marconi defence arm.
The paper said GEC would also demerge its GEC-Alsthom joint venture and sell its 60 percent stake in telecoms equipment group GPT, where it did not have overall control.
It quoted unnamed analysts as saying that a long-rumoured merger with British Aerospace Plc was again being tipped.

Interest in the review was revived by the departure last week of long-serving finance director David Newlands. "People are going to watch this situation very closely...they expect Simpson possibly to be quite radical," said one dealer.
Other press reports said GEC was poised to take over Italian defence firm Alenia Difensa, controlled by state-owned Finmeccania SpA.
No-one at GEC was immediately available for comment.
